nudges.text: Find the oldest thing within arm's reach. Imagine the first person who touched it.
Go outside. Turn left. Walk for exactly 3 minutes. Then come back.
Touch the coldest surface you can find. Then the warmest.
Stand at a window. Describe what you see out loud, as if to someone who can't see it.
Find something you own that's broken or damaged. Hold it for a minute.
Open a drawer or cabinet you rarely open. Look at what's inside for 30 seconds. Close it.
Listen. Identify 5 distinct sounds. Say each one out loud as you hear it.
Walk to the furthest corner of wherever you are. Stand there for 60 seconds.
Pick up the nearest book. Open to page 50. Read the first full sentence out loud.
Find something blue. Then find something that's almost the same blue, but not quite.
Go outside. Watch the first moving thing you see until it's gone.
Look at your ceiling. Keep looking until you notice something you've never noticed before.
Find the ugliest thing in the room. Look at it for 30 seconds without looking away.
Find a mirror. Make eye contact with yourself for 30 seconds.
Find something you forgot you owned. Hold it. Try to remember when you got it.
